message.content:
This is the usememos/memos Go project. Memos have a visibility field: PUBLIC, PROTECTED, PRIVATE. I need to find EVERY distinct server-side enforcement site where memo visibility (who may VIEW/read a memo) is checked/enforced. There are at least three distinct sites.

Look across the server code (internal/server, server/, internal/store, etc.) for places that:
- filter memo list queries by visibility based on the requesting user (e.g. building SQL/store filters that add visibility conditions)
- check visibility when fetching a single memo (GetMemo) and return permission-denied if the current user cannot view it
- enforce visibility in any other surface: gRPC/API service methods, REST/RSS/atom feeds, attachment/resource access tied to a memo, comments, reactions, etc.

For each enforcement site, give me the exact file path and the function/method name and a short quote of the visibility check code. Be very thorough — search for "Visibility", "VISIBILITY_PRIVATE", "VISIBILITY_PROTECTED", "PermissionDenied", "CreatorID", "VisibilityList" etc. Report the full list with file paths.

content.text:
I have gathered all enforcement sites. Here is the complete list.

## Memo visibility (read/VIEW) enforcement sites in usememos/memos

### Tier 1 — The actual store-level SQL filter (where `VisibilityList` becomes a WHERE clause)
These three driver functions translate `FindMemo.VisibilityList` (and the CEL `visibility in [...]` filter) into SQL. This is the low-level enforcement that every list query funnels through.

- `/bench/home/work/store/db/sqlite/memo.go` — `listMemos` (~line 96)
  ```go
  if v := find.VisibilityList; len(v) != 0 {
      ...
      where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("`memo`.`visibility` IN (%s)", ...))
  }
  ```
- `/bench/home/work/store/db/mysql/memo.go` — `listMemos` (~line 104) — same `visibility IN (...)` construction.
- `/bench/home/work/store/db/postgres/memo.go` — `listMemos` (~line 89) — same construction.
- Field definition: `/bench/home/work/store/memo.go` — `FindMemo.VisibilityList []Visibility` (line 69).

### Tier 2 — Single-memo read gate (GetMemo)
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — `checkMemoReadAccess` (lines 55–66). This is the central single-memo permission gate:
  ```go
  if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
      user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
      ...
      if user == nil { return ...Unauthenticated... }
      if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
          return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
      }
  }
  ```
  Called by `GetMemo` (line 356) and for the parent memo of a comment (line 367). Also called by `ListMemoComments` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148`.

### Tier 3 — List query visibility construction (per-user filter building)
These set `VisibilityList` / append a CEL `visibility in [...]` filter based on the requesting user before calling the store.

- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — `ListMemos` (lines 218–227):
  ```go
  if currentUser == nil {
      memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public}
  } else {
      if memoFind.CreatorID == nil {
          filter := fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
          memoFind.Filters = append(memoFind.Filters, filter)
      } else if *memoFind.CreatorID != currentUser.ID {
          memoFind.VisibilityList = []store.Visibility{store.Public, store.Protected}
      }
  }
  ```
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go` — `ListAllUserStats` (lines 84–91): identical pattern (Public for anon; `creator_id == X || visibility in [...]` otherwise).
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go` — `GetUserStats` (lines 217–221): Public for anon, Public+Protected when viewing another user.

### Tier 4 — Reactions
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` — `ListMemoReactions` (lines 30–41): `if memo.Visibility != store.Public { ... if Private && CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) → PermissionDenied }`.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` — `UpsertMemoReaction` (lines 83–85): `if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) → PermissionDenied`.

### Tier 5 — Comments
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` — `CreateMemoComment` (line 41): `if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) → PermissionDenied`. (Line 100 gates comment-created notification visibility, not read access.)
- `ListMemoComments` reuses `checkMemoReadAccess` (line 148, see Tier 2).

### Tier 6 — Attachments/resources tied to a memo
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` — `ListMemoAttachments` (lines 214–225): `if memo.Visibility != store.Public { ... Private && CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser → PermissionDenied }`.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go` — `checkAttachmentAccess` (lines 445–453): `if memo.Visibility == store.Public { return nil } ... if Private && CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser → PermissionDenied`. Called from `GetAttachment`/download path (line 256).
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` — `checkAttachmentPermission` (lines 677–701): raw blob/file serving gate — anonymous only if `Public && AllowAnonymous()`, share-token fallback, else `if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin → StatusForbidden`. Called at line 149.

### Tier 7 — Feeds and public surfaces (hardcoded Public-only)
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/rss/rss.go` — `GetExploreRSS` (line 90) and `GetUserRSS` (line 141): both set `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}`.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/frontend/frontend.go` — `getSitemapXML` (line 150): `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}`.

### Related (visibility-driven, but NOT read enforcement — for completeness)
These check visibility to decide notification/mention behavior, not to gate who may view a memo:
- `/bench/home/work/server/notification/email.go` (lines 313–316) — skip email if Private/Protected.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` (lines 309–312) — same notification gating.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go` (lines 62, 67, 84) — whether a mention notification is delivered based on Private visibility.

### Summary of the distinct read-enforcement surfaces
1. Store SQL filter (sqlite/mysql/postgres `listMemos`) — the base list enforcement.
2. `checkMemoReadAccess` (single memo GetMemo + comment parent + ListMemoComments).
3. `ListMemos` per-user filter construction; plus `ListAllUserStats` / `GetUserStats`.
4. Reactions (`ListMemoReactions`, `UpsertMemoReaction`).
5. Comments (`CreateMemoComment`).
6. Attachments (`ListMemoAttachments`, `checkAttachmentAccess`, fileserver `checkAttachmentPermission`).
7. Feeds/sitemap (RSS `GetExploreRSS`/`GetUserRSS`, frontend `getSitemapXML`).

Note the common predicate shape: `Visibility == store.Private && CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user)` in the API-v1 services (super-user bypass), versus `user.Role != store.RoleAdmin` in the fileserver, versus the plain `memo.CreatorID != user.ID` (no super-user bypass) in `checkMemoReadAccess`.
